notes.title: Recommended Driver, Gameplay Updates, and Fixes
notes.content:
[h1]Recommended Driver for Game Performance[/h1]
[list]
[*] The latest NVIDIA driver versions on the R580 release branch (580.88 and 580.97) have a known critical performance issue which can result in the application crashing. 
 
[*] [b]Our recommended NVIDIA driver version is now 576.88[/b] which has been verified to not be affected by this issue. 

[*] If you are experiencing frequent crashes playing Deadzone: Rogue on NVIDIA hardware, we suggest checking your installed driver version to see if it is affected. The NVIDIA driver team is aware of the issue and is working to resolve it in a future driver update.

[h2]How to check your NVIDIA driver version[/h2]
[*] [b]Open the NVIDIA Control Panel[/b]: Right-click on your desktop and select "NVIDIA Control Panel".
[*] [b]Access System Information[/b]: In the NVIDIA Control Panel, click "System Information" located in the bottom-left corner.
[*] [b]Locate Driver Version[/b]: The driver version will be listed next to the "Driver Version" field within the system information window. Note that this usually represents the last five digits of the full version number. 
[*] [b]If Affected[/b]: If your driver is 580.88 or 580.97, consider visiting the Nvidia website to download the recommended driver instead or another version of your choice.
[/list]

[i]“Hey! Who turned out the lights?!”[/i]

[*] New wave mission in Zone 2!
[*] Rewards a new Experimental weapon - Plasma Cycler

[h2]Improved Co-Op Flow & Support[/h2]
We've made a wide variety of improvements to improve the co-op experience!

[h3]Updated Multiplayer Flow [/h3]
[*] Seamless Steam and EGS invitations added
[*] Added new console in the starting ship for game session management
[*] Offline mode: will allow no one to join your game
[*] Friends Only mode: will only allow friends to join
[*] Public mode: will publish your game to the Server Browser for anyone to join

[b]NOTE: Multiplayer menu has been moved into a new console in the starting ship. You no longer need to click "coop" on the main menu to access multi player mode.[/b] 

[h3]Better Reconnect Capability[/h3]
[*] If a joining player in co-op disconnects from a run, they will be prompted upon relaunching to rejoin the session. 
[*] Reconnecting to a run will load the player back in with the full loadout the player had when they disconnected.

[h3]Added Late Join Support[/h3]
[*] Joining a lobby in the middle of a mission will put the player in spectate until the mission is over
[*] Spectating players will join when the host returns to the starting ship

[h3]More Granular Permission System[/h3]
[*] Can now ban players from sessions
[*] Mute option also added
[*] Permission control (server browser, friends only/join code, offline) now changeable at any time
[*] Made several Improvements to server browser

[h3]Loot Sharing[/h3]
[*] Players can now easily share loot by pinging it! No more picking up and dropping to share.

We've added in-game text chat for improved multiplayer communication during co-op missions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45207649/a610b85b2cb702833730b9a9f0d5e1fe5984adc5.gif[/img]

[*] Text Chat: (default ENTER)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45207649/422a2e79c4adcf714bf6e11b2c8e80396501eaac.jpg[/img]

[h2]Bot Updates[/h2]
[*] Added clearer tells for Man-Spider’s AOE jump attack
[*] Fixed an issue where the Flamethrower would be able to damage players through walls and floors
[*] Fixed an issue where the CEO Clone was missing elemental immunity.

[h2]General Gameplay[/h2]
[*] Made the Ready-up prompt for wave based missions more clear
[*] Added an accessibility option for auto-shooting single shot and burst weapons
[*] The option to delete saves has been restored and moved to the main menu settings
[*] Applying an elemental activator to an enemy now always applies that element’s debuff, even if you do not have the corresponding elemental perk
[*] Kills from elemental activators now activate on-kill effects triggered by the affixed weapon (i.e. stealth on kill, bullet refund on kill, etc.)
[*] Gyro support improvements
[*] Added player space aiming as an alternative to the previous local space aiming
[*] Added an option for the gyro reset behavior to suspend input while held instead of resetting the vertical axis

[h2]Audio[/h2]
[*] Added SFX that plays when a teammate dies or is revived.
[*] Made currency pickup sound attenuated and audible to other players.

[h2]Fixes[/h2]
[*] Fixed an issue where joining clients’ starting pistol would not be visible upon loading into a mission. 
[*] Fixed an issue in co-op where joining players would not see the wave counter for Last Stand increase after wave 33.
[*] Fixed an issue where Super Items would show as level 1 if continuing from a saved run. 
[*] Fixed an issue in co-op where currency could not be picked up by joining players.
[*] Fixed an issue where continuing a saved run would offset the encounter count. 
[*] Fixed an issue where Planty events would not play properly while in co-op.
[*] Fixed a crash that would occur if an external controller was plugged in while playing on a SteamDeck.

[h2]Known Issues[/h2]
[*] Cannot scroll friends list with gamepads. Clicking the bottom of the scroll bar works for navigating down the menu, as a temporary solution. We'll get this fixed as soon as possible!

[h2]Happy Summer Fest! [/h2]
If you have any friends that might like Deadzone, now's a great time for them to hop in! We hope this co-op experience feels even better than before for everyone.

And of course, let us know about any feedback or issues in discord.gg/deadzonerogue in #feedback anytime, thanks!

Cheers
Prophecy Team

notes.title: Fixes for Weapon Skin Rewards, Controller Support, and More
notes.content:
[h1]Patch Notes - Version 0.3.0.2[/h1]

[h2]Weapon Skin Fixes[/h2]

- Weapon skins are now correctly set to be rewarded retroactively if missions have already been completed. Enjoy!

- Fixed an issue where weapon skins were not granting from some missions.

- Weapon skins are now correctly set to be received based on the highest level of difficulty completed for a mission. For example, if you complete a mission on 'hard' difficulty, you will receive the weapon skins for 'easy', 'medium', and 'hard' difficulties for that mission.

- Fixed an issue where default skin option's tooltip and unlocked state was not updating properly.

[h2]Controller Fixes[/h2]

- Added a temporary fix for the issue where the interact button ('Y' button on controller, for example) was not working.

- Dev Note - This fix will block swapping weapons in the Last Stand mission during a portion of the prepare phase. We will continue to work on a better fix to support multiple keybinds on gamepad.

[h2]Last Stand Fixes[/h2]

- Fixed an issue where the Last Stand mission did not allow for legendary upgrades in the fabricator.

- Fixed an issue where if a player disconnected in Last Stand, their co-op partners would get soft locked from their loot orbs not destroying.

[h2]UI Fixes[/h2]

- Fixed an issue where the Superior Items screen would overflow off the screen boundary.

- Fixed an issue where Superior Items tooltips would show them as level 1 if the player saved and returned to a continued run.

- Fixed an issue where the run time did not support displaying hours.

[h2]Thank You[/h2]

Thanks again everyone for the feedback, keep it coming. Sorry for any bugs - there were some configuration issues that snuck in, as we pushed hard to get the patch out in time for Zombie Fest!

Hope these changes help right away, and we'll continue to monitor Discord, Steam, and QQ to spot any bugs and for suggestions. Appreciate all the support, more to come!

- Prophecy Team

notes.title: Added Offline Single Player Mode, a New Mission, and More
notes.content:
[h1]Patch Notes: Version 0.1.1.0[/h1]

[h2]Added Offline Single Player Mode[/h2]

Players can now enjoy Deadzone's single-player mode offline, without an internet connection! This was our top requested feature, and the #1 priority for our team to deliver this week. We really wanted to address this for the community ASAP, and hope you can enjoy the improved experience this weekend!

Note: This is a large change for our back-end systems. We expect performance to be stable after internal testing, but will monitor the patch to make sure it acts as expected. Co-op mode will also still require an online connection, so players can share the same game experience in real time.

[h2]Added a new mission, Uniform Chaos II[/h2]

In this mission, each room randomly spawns a horde of the same type of enemies to defeat. This approach builds on the Uniform Chaos I mission, and offers an even deeper level of enemy variety and challenge for experienced players. This mission can be found in Zone 2, we hope you enjoy it!

[h2]Balance Improvements[/h2]

[b]Bots[/b]
- Replaced the Laser Crawler in Headhunter Mission with Nyxis.

[b]Weapons[/b]
- Dual SMGS: Reduced Spread by 20%, and doubled proc rate

[b]General Gameplay[/b]

- Updated the respawn system in co-op mode
- When a player dies in co-op, they will now respawn at the exit doors.
- Implemented several safety checks to ensure players will respawn after an encounter.
- Exit doors will now automatically open after 10 seconds.

- Players can only quick melee/lunge once while in the air.
- Added a new description tag for Experimental weapons.
- Lowered the sounds for crit hit and headshots.

[h2]Fixes[/h2]
- Fixed more soft lock issues with Zone 2.
- Fixed an issue where lightning barrels would instantly kill players in the Headhunter mission.
- Fixed an issue where when player took self-damage or damage from DOTs, hit feedback indicators would always be oriented towards the origin.
- Fixed an issue where joining players in coop would see Singularity disappear slightly before it had actually expired.
- Fixed an issue where when using the Dual SMGs, the player's shoulders would clip through their body.
- Fixed an issue where pet bots would not respawn in co-op after their owner respawned.
- Fixed an issue where in co-op, if a player with ammo enhancements drops a weapon, the weapon will retain its ammo stack from the original owner.
- Fixed an issue where the Zone 1 boss could be meleed while its shield was up.
- Fixed an issue where reloads would not be paused if the player was frozen.
- Fixed an issue where bosses would not properly focus players as their main priority.
- Fixed an issue where the Elemental Siege Construct's projectile was disappearing prematurely.
- Fixed an issue where Spider bots had some trouble attacking players on top of boxes.

We wanted to get something special out for everyone to enjoy this weekend, good luck and have fun! We're all tired after a long week (we've pushed a patch or two every day since the launch), but it's been worth it and so exciting to see the game growing to nearly 100,000 players so quickly.

Thanks again to everyone for taking the leap into early access with us, and wishing you all the best!

- Prophecy Team

notes.title: Deadzone Rogue has Launched into Early Access!

[previewyoutube=gRtuhD0R-AM;full][/previewyoutube]

Deadzone is a roguelite FPS set in deep space - this release includes 30+ unique weapons, 100+ items and augments, and multiple elements that you can mix to create fun new builds for each run.

A third chapter is planned to come in the next few months, and we'll keep making updates to improve the game in the meantime, so let us know any feedback you have in the Discord (discord.gg/deadzonerogue) or in the Steam reviews! 

With this release, we'll build on momentum from the demo (90%+ positive reviews), along with over 150,000 wishlists pre-launch. Thanks again to everyone for your support, it means a lot!
